ffff_framework.findings_goal: Audit CT_VAULT Obsidian plugins: dataview version, blueprint version, obsidian-linter version; check daily-dashboard.md.j2 template compatibility
ffff_framework.flags_goal: YELLOW: dataview queries using outdated syntax; RED: blueprint templates clash with Jinja2 rendering; YELLOW: frontmatter confuses Obsidian parser
ffff_framework.flow_goal: Daily folder auto-opens → daily-dashboard.md.j2 renders → Obsidian loads template → dataview queries execute → metrics display
ffff_framework.friction_goal: Version mismatches break queries; blueprint conflicts prevent templating; Obsidian parser chokes on mixed metadata

critical_context.vault_plugins: Check .obsidian/community-plugins.json and .obsidian/manifest.json for: dataview, blueprint, obsidian-linter, obsidian-kanban (if used)
critical_context.rendering_pipeline: Jinja2 renders template → Obsidian parses YAML frontmatter → dataview queries execute → metrics display

audit_scope.plugin_versions: Are dataview + blueprint versions compatible? Check CHANGELOG for breaking changes (2026 Q1-Q2)
audit_scope.dataview_queries: Which query syntax is used? Is it compatible with installed dataview version?
audit_scope.blueprint_templates: Do blueprint templates conflict with Jinja2 delimiters ({{ }})? Can they coexist?
audit_scope.frontmatter_parsing: Does Obsidian YAML parser handle Jinja2-generated frontmatter correctly?
audit_scope.daily_folder_setup: Does CT_VAULT have daily-{YYYY-MM-DD}/ folder template? Does it auto-open on startup?

success_criteria.query_audit: List all dataview queries in template; flag any using deprecated syntax
success_criteria.template_fixes: If conflicts exist, propose solutions: separate blueprint/dataview sections, or use template preprocessing
success_criteria.plugin_pinning: Recommend exact versions for .obsidian/manifest.json to ensure reproducibility
success_criteria.compass_edge: S if all plugins compatible and queries work; E if uncertain (need test render); W if major conflicts found
